title: ItemCategoryDef
description:
An item category definition from JSON type `"ITEM_CATEGORY"`.

Defines a category for organizing items in inventory screens and sorting loot (e.g. weapons, ammo, food, tools).

group_under_default.description: Whether items in this category are grouped under a default subcategory.

name_header.description: Header name displayed in the inventory category listing.

name_noun.description: Noun name used for referring to a single item of this category.

priority.description: Priority for sorting within the category.

sort_rank.description: Sort rank for ordering categories in lists.

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
